# Coachella 2026: The full lineup and schedule revealed
Set to take place across two consecutive weekends from April 10-12 and April 17-19, Coachella 2026 has unveiled its full performance schedule, bringing together one of its most internationally expansive lineups to date.
Spanning pop, indie, electronic and global acts, this year’s programme reflects a festival that continues to move beyond genre boundaries, offering a broader snapshot of how music is evolving across regions and audiences.
Headlining this year’s edition are Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber and Karol G, each leading one day across both weekends. Carpenter opens on April 10 and 17, joined by acts including The xx, Teddy Swims and Central Cee.
On April 11 and 18, Bieber makes his long-awaited Coachella headlining debut – following several guest appearances in earlier years – marking his first time leading the main stage, with the same day also featuring The Strokes, Giveon and Addison Rae.
Closing on April 12 and 19, Karol G leads a lineup that includes Young Thug and Laufey, underscoring the continued global rise of Latin pop alongside cross-genre programming.

...

The reach extends to J-Pop as well, with Fujii Kaze set for April 11 and 18 and hip-hop duo Creepy Nuts appearing on April 10 and 17, reinforcing the festival’s increasingly global scope.

WASHINGTON (SBG) - After having to put their yearly festival on ice due to the coronavirus pandemic, [Coachella](https://coachella.com/) has announced an official return in April 2022.
Organizers of the music and arts festival announced on Tuesday, Coachella will be returning April 15-17 and April 22-24, 2022, being held on back-to-back weekends.
"See you in the desert," a post from Coachella's Twitter account reads.
[View post on X](https://twitter.com/i/web/status/1399772462422773761)
Since its debut in 1999, Coachella has become one of the world's largest and most famous music festivals. Coachella was one of the first festivals to react when the pandemic hit the U.S. in 2020, originally moving its date from April 2020 to October 2020, before being pushed again to April 2021.
While the lineup for its return has not been released, tickets for Coachella 2022 will be available on June 4th at 10 a.m. PST.
